notes: MUNCHIE CANDY (zombies): pick a pack of 4 from 10 candies in the zombies lobby. Each round one is in your pocket - press the SCORESTREAK key (X / D-pad up) to eat it: SOUR BLAST, GUMMY ANGEL (a free get-up), ROCK CANDY, FIZZY WHIZZ, SUGAR RUSH, REFILL ROPE, JACKPOT WRAPPER, LUCKY LOLLY (free crate), MINT CONDITION and COTTON CLOUD (zombies lose you).

UPGRADE CAMOS: guns from the upgrader now wear an animated camo that belongs to the map - NIGHTSHADE (glowing purple veins) in the hospital, HELLFIRE (molten cracks) at THE WORKS and JET STREAM (blue streaks) at TERMINAL 9.
